description: This file defines a configuration class for a Cohere reranking API integration within a larger language model framework. It includes methods for building API URLs, parameter validation and transformation, environment setup, and response handling for reranking tasks.

classes.name: CohereRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with Cohere's rerank API, providing utility functions for URL generation, parameter mapping, validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the Cohere rerank API endpoint based on the base URL and model.

methods.name: list get_supported_cohere_rerank_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for Cohere reranking API.

methods.name: Dict map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: Optional[dict], model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps input parameters into a dictionary suitable for the rerank request, including optional parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares API headers, especially the API key, for making API requests.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a structured rerank request object compatible with Cohere API.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response from Cohere, parsing JSON and returning a RerankResponse object.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an exception class instance for handling API errors specific to Cohere.
